title: KamalSaiVoodika/RAG-Document-Chat
summary: KamalSaiVoodika的RAG-Document-Chat是一个使用Flutter开发的Flutter应用程序，实现了从零开始的检索增强生成（RAG）。用户可以上传PDF或文本文档，然后提出问题并得到基于该文档内容的答案，使用Google Gemini进行嵌入和生成。，基于模型推理的架构
description: A Flutter application implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) from scratch — upload a PDF or text document, then ask questions and get answers grounded specifically in that document's content, using Google Gemini for embeddings and generation.
